label: 步骤 1
cn: 步骤 1：物料清单核对——确认所有核心部件齐全：高速无刷电机、PCB 控制板、加热元件、温度传感器等。
en: Step 1: BOM Verification — Confirm all core components are present: high-speed brushless motor, PCB control board, heating element, temperature sensor, and more.

label: 步骤 2
cn: 步骤 2：PCB 控制板安装——采用 SMT 表面贴装焊接工艺，将 MCU、MOSFET 及其他元件焊接至电路板；通电后检查电压输出与 PWM 信号反馈是否正常。
en: Step 2: PCB Assembly — Using SMT (Surface Mount Technology), solder the MCU, MOSFETs, and other components onto the board. After powering on, verify voltage output and PWM signal feedback.

label: 步骤 3
cn: 步骤 3：高速电机模块组装——将无刷电机嵌入专用支架，把电机三相线固定焊接在 PCB 板上，并用热缩管绝缘。
en: Step 3: High-Speed Motor Module Assembly — Seat the brushless motor in its dedicated bracket, solder the three-phase wires to the PCB, and insulate with heat-shrink tubing.

label: 步骤 4
cn: 步骤 4：加热元件安装——将 PTC 发热片固定在云母支架上，两侧覆盖云母绝缘层。
en: Step 4: Heating Element Installation — Fix the PTC heating elements to the mica brackets and cover both sides with mica insulation.

label: 步骤 5
cn: 步骤 5：风管系统集成——将叶轮与电机轴对齐，按压至卡入槽内；安装导风罩，并确保风道内无毛刺。
en: Step 5: Air Duct System Integration — Align the impeller with the motor shaft and press until it locks into the groove. Install the air guide cover and ensure the air duct is free of burrs.

label: 步骤 6
cn: 步骤 6：外壳预安装——前壳组件嵌入滤光片；后壳组件安装电源线与模式开关。
en: Step 6: Housing Pre-Assembly — Insert the light filter into the front housing; install the power cord and mode switch in the rear housing.

label: 步骤 7
cn: 步骤 7：密封与封装——上下壳体对齐，采用超声波焊接与耐高温扣锁，并进行气密性测试。
en: Step 7: Sealing and Enclosure — Align the upper and lower housings, join them using ultrasonic welding and heat-resistant latches, then perform an airtightness test.

label: 步骤 8
cn: 步骤 8：各项测试——冷风模式全速运行 5 分钟；热风模式持续运行 40 分钟，并检测温度梯度。
en: Step 8: Testing — Run at full speed in cool-air mode for 5 minutes; run in hot-air mode continuously for 40 minutes while monitoring the temperature gradient.

label: 步骤 9
cn: 步骤 9：纸箱包装——产品采用坚固纸箱包装，以便安全搬运与运输。
en: Step 9: Carton Packaging — Pack products in sturdy cartons for safe handling and transport.

label: 步骤 10
cn: 步骤 10：集装箱装载——为确保长途运输中的额外保护，将产品妥善装入航空/货运箱。
en: Step 10: Container Loading — For added protection during long-haul transport, place products securely in shipping cases.

label: 样品测试标题

label: 样品正文
cn: 样品是优质组件与高质量批量生产之间的桥梁。在 APOWER 电器，我们的独特做法是在最严苛条件下反复测试样品，确保所有组件正常工作、性能可靠。样品通过测试后，质检团队将记录其规格，并为批量生产提供物料清单。
en: Samples bridge quality components and high-quality mass production. At APOWER TECH, we repeatedly test samples under the most stringent conditions to ensure all components function correctly and perform reliably. Once a sample passes, the QC team records its specifications and provides the BOM for mass production.

label: 电性能标题
cn: 电子性能测试：为安全应用保驾护航
en: Electronic Performance Testing: Engineered for Safety

label: 电性能 1
cn: 1. 电压频率抗扰度测试：模拟不同环境下使用不同规格的电压发生器，测试吹风机能否正常使用，以及过载保护功能是否有效。
en: 1. Voltage and frequency immunity testing: Simulating voltage generators of various specifications under different environments to verify normal operation and the effectiveness of overload protection.

label: 电性能 2
cn: 2. 壳料熔点试验：提高吹风机样品加热丝温度并调整外壳防火材料比例，测试内壳材料的极限熔点。
en: 2. Housing melting-point testing: Raising the heating wire temperature and adjusting the proportion of fire-resistant material to determine the ultimate melting point of the inner housing.

label: 电性能 3
cn: 3. 电气参数测试：将产品连接至直流电源，获取精确的电气参数，包括电源效率、电压、电流、瓦特数及功率数据等。
en: 3. Electrical parameter testing: Connecting the product to a DC power supply to obtain precise parameters, including power efficiency, voltage, current, wattage, and power data.

label: 电性能 4
cn: 4. 跌落与振动测试：将样品从离地 1.5 米高处跌落，再置于振动架上，测试其能否承受冲击并正常工作。
en: 4. Drop and vibration testing: Dropping samples from a height of 1.5 meters and then placing them on a vibration rack to verify they withstand impact and continue to function.

Our rigorous quality control is embedded in the methodology and standardization of every process, eliminating non-conforming products at the detail level so that what you receive is flawless.

Engineering & quotation: for full transparency, we provide detailed development pricing and explain how the new appliance will be engineered from the final design.

Estimation & analysis: after reviewing your design and ideas, we estimate the effort and time required, build a clear schedule, and keep you updated. Mold making: at our in-house mold and injection facility, we adjust molds to precise dimensions and create new models for rapid production.

Prototyping & approval: using 3D technology, we provide 3D drawings and produce prototype samples for your inspection to confirm the design meets your specifications. label: 主板标题
cn: 主板驱动制造
en: Mainboard Driver Manufacturing

label: 主板正文
cn: 驱动主板是吹风机的核心组件，决定了产品的各项功能参数、不同模式下的温度、工作电压及其他关键数据。APOWER 电器自主设计、制造并测试吹风机驱动器，确保产品具备始终如一的卓越品质与性能。驱动器制造过程极其严谨，工人必须按照设计将所有组件精准安装与连接；完成后进行功能测试，确保驱动器正常工作。
en: The driver mainboard is the core component of a hair dryer, determining functional parameters, temperatures across modes, operating voltage, and other key data. APOWER TECH designs, manufactures, and tests its drivers in-house to ensure consistent, outstanding quality and performance. The process is highly rigorous: workers must precisely install and connect every component according to design, followed by functional testing to confirm the driver works properly.

label: 电机标题
cn: 高速电机制造：电机生产全过程
en: High-Speed Motor Manufacturing: The Full Process

label: 电机正文
cn: APOWER 电器拥有独立的高速电机研发与生产部门，掌握了电机生产核心工艺中的“高精度转子设计”。我们掌控了从“高精度转子设计”“定子绕组制造及热管理”“轴承系统设计及安装”到电机“动平衡及振动控制”的整个流程，攻克了高速电机在材料强度、散热效率、支撑稳定性与振动抑制等方面的核心难题，确保电机高效可靠运行。
en: APOWER TECH has an independent R&D and production department for high-speed motors, mastering the core process of high-precision rotor design. We control the entire process — from high-precision rotor design, stator winding and thermal management, and bearing system design and installation, to dynamic balancing and vibration control. This allows us to solve the core challenges of material strength, heat dissipation, support stability, and vibration suppression, ensuring efficient, reliable motor performance.

label: 注塑标题
cn: 产品壳料注塑：模具设计
en: Housing Injection Molding: Mold Design

label: 注塑正文 1
cn: 基于对制造灵活性的深入分析，APOWER 电器与领先的模具设计机构合作，共同打造吹风机外壳。精心设计的模具确保成型工艺高效、安全。我们采用先进的数控机床与水刀切割机，生产精度高达 0.01 毫米以内的高精度模具，打造完美成型的外壳。
en: Based on in-depth analysis of manufacturing flexibility, APOWER TECH partners with leading mold design institutions to develop hair dryer housings. Carefully designed molds ensure efficient, safe molding. Using advanced CNC machines and water-jet cutters, we produce high-precision molds with accuracy within 0.01 mm for perfectly formed housings.

label: 注塑正文 2
cn: 外壳注塑成型：我们从泰国采购塑料颗粒，确保以最优价格获得最佳原材料；采用世界一流的 YIZUMI（伊之密）注塑机，使注塑过程可靠、精准。
en: Injection molding: we source plastic pellets from Thailand to secure the best raw materials at the best prices, and we use world-class YIZUMI injection molding machines for a reliable, precise process.

label: 总装标题
cn: 高速吹风机制造：所有部件的组装
en: High-Speed Hair Dryer Manufacturing: Assembly of All Components

label: 总装正文

en: Once the drivers, motors, and housings are ready, all components move to the assembly workshop. APOWER TECH follows standardized assembly procedures and provides a BOM for each model detailing the correct assembly methods and standards. All workers must complete assembly strictly according to the BOM.

label: 测试包装

en: Testing and packaging: assembled products undergo a 40-minute burn-in test at 110V–220V. Only qualified units move to the packaging line for carton packing.

en: 20. I have another quote at a lower price.  We can try to match your target price, but a lower price generally means lower quality — an outcome we believe neither of us wants.

en: 21. Can you ship via FedEx?  Yes, and we also offer additional cost-saving options.

en: 22. What shipping methods do you use?  By sea or air, and by land in some regions. We have long-term contracts with many forwarders and express carriers.
